regimeSub: Warsh's Jackson Hole hawkish tilt meets sticky 3.7% CPI and slowing 1.5% GDP—rate hike bets surge.
themes: Fed Chair Warsh's Aug 28 Jackson Hole speech signaled rates may rise → 2Y yields +109bps YoY to 4.65%, Sept hike now base case
Aug CPI accelerated to 3.7% YoY (vs 3.5% prior) with core PCE at 3.3% → 10Y hits 4.97%, highest since 2007, bond selloff deepens
BOK raised to 3.0% in Aug on chip-driven inflation; KOSPI +6663 on HBM demand → KRW strengthens to 1365 but BOK warns of Fed spillover risk
Houthis seize Red Sea port, Saudi output disrupted despite June Iran ceasefire → Brent at $107.72, adding 20bps to headline CPI pass-through

headline: Warsh's hawkish pivot collides with stagflationary data—3.7% CPI and 1.5% GDP lock in September hike odds while $107 Brent and Red Sea disruptions keep inflation risk elevated.
